signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to keep your stats, friends and settings on every device.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: An account is optional: you can play every game without one.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

hints.password: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
hints.nickname: 3 to 20 letters or digits. You can also use _ and .
hints.birthDate: You must be 13 or older. We only keep the year.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a link to reset its password is on the way.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.

onboarding.title: Finish your account
onboarding.description: Pick a nickname and confirm your age to start using your account.

merge.title: Move your guest progress?
merge.description: You played as a guest on this device. You can move that progress into the account you just signed in to.
merge.failed: We couldn't move your guest progress. Try again, or continue without it.

callback.failed: We couldn't sign you in. The link may have expired or already been used.

errors.passwordWeak: Use at least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in to it instead.
errors.identityTaken: That account is already connected to another kefche account. Sign in with it instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.ageRestricted: Sorry, you must be 13 or older to create an account.
errors.birthDateInvalid: Enter a valid month and year.
errors.nicknameCharacters: Use only letters, digits, _ and . (not at the start or end, and not two dots in a row).
errors.nicknameReserved: This nickname is reserved. Pick another one.
errors.nicknameBlocked: This nickname isn't allowed. Pick another one.
errors.nicknameTaken: This nickname is taken. Pick another one.
errors.network: We couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
